one_line: The conjecture remains open, but the required lower comparison holds with constant 1/2 for digraphs admitting a regular abelian automorphism group, and d(p)=c(p)=p for every prime p.
caveats: This is a restricted, elementary case and does not improve the stated universal Omega(n^{1/3}) bound or handle general non-Cayley vertex-transitive digraphs.
